system.description:
Requirements: You must receive training from a Black Dragon or another follower of the Path of Black Flames, or have access to their teachings

You have learned to control the calamitous power of Black Flame, a sacred art cultivated by Black Dragons and those whom they deign to share their knowledge with. Few things can equal its destructive power, but to overuse Black Flame is inevitably fatal to the wielder.

  • Select 1 Path Ability with the Black Flame trait. You immediately gain that Ability without the associated XP cost.

  • When you use an ability with the Black Flame trait, you can choose to take Wounds instead of spending Resolve to use the ability.

  • As a Free Action, you can harden Black Flame across your body in the form of ethereal scales, granting you +1 Armor until you choose to release the effect.

    • This armor can be destroyed by Magical weapons with the Rend trait. If this happens, you cannot use the ability again until you complete a Long Rest.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.N0iUSUphFM5Vs1RV]{Path of Black Flames}
